# Functions and transformations — summary

**Domain restrictions:** no division by $0$ · square root needs $\geq 0$ · logarithm needs $> 0$.

**Composite 🧠:** $(f \circ g)(x) = f(g(x))$ — inside first.

**Inverse 🧠:** swap $x$ and $y$, make $y$ the subject. Graph: reflection in $y = x$. Domain of $f^{-1}$ = range of $f$.

**Rational $\dfrac{ax + b}{cx + d}$ 🧠:** VA $x = -\dfrac{d}{c}$ · HA $y = \dfrac{a}{c}$ · $x$-int $-\dfrac{b}{a}$ · $y$-int $\dfrac{b}{d}$. $\ \dfrac{1}{x}$ is self-inverse.

| Transformation 🧠 | Effect on $y = f(x)$ |
|---|---|
| $f(x) + b$ | up $b$ |
| $f(x - a)$ | right $a$ |
| $p\,f(x)$ | vertical stretch, factor $p$ |
| $f(qx)$ | horizontal stretch, factor $\dfrac{1}{q}$ |
| $-f(x)$ | reflect in $x$-axis |
| $f(-x)$ | reflect in $y$-axis |

**Technology (Paper 2):** unfamiliar equations → graph both sides, intersection. Write the equation you solved.

**Watch out:** $f^{-1}(x) \neq \dfrac{1}{f(x)}$ · $f(x + 3)$ moves **left** · ranges are written with $f(x)$ or $y$.
